thread.title: Samsung Electronics: New iPhone Still An Opportunity - Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. (OTCMKTS:SSNLF)

author: Hyundai Motor Investment & Securities
title: Samsung Electronics: New iPhone Still An Opportunity - Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. (OTCMKTS:SSNLF)
text:
Investment highlights We maintain BUY on Samsung Electronics ( OTC:SSNLF ) but trim our six-month-forward target price from KRW66,000 (the average of 10x 2018F EPS and 1.7x 2018F BPS) to KRW63,000 (the average of 10x 2018F EPS and 1.6x 2018F BPS). We also revise down our 2Q18 revenue and operating profit forecasts by 4.5% and 4.9% to KRW58.4tn and KRW14.9tn, respectively, in reflection of sluggish smartphone sales and NAND price declines. We expect 2Q18 smartphone shipments to be 73mn units and the Galaxy S9/S9+ shipments to fall below our previous forecast by 23%. Accordingly, we adjust our estimate for IM operating profit down 9.5%. We previously thought NAND blended ASP would decrease 5% QoQ but it looks like it will go down further given an 11-18% QoQ decline in TLC wafer prices (128Gb/256Gb) amid weak smartphone sales. However, semiconductor operating profit is likely to be 1.6% below our previous estimate at KRW12.1tn due to DRAM price hikes and recent KRW weakness. Meanwhile, earnings from display are expected to be sluggish as Samsung Display’s A3 plant’s utilization is still running below 50%. However, we believe the downward adjustment of earnings will not hamper the company’s fundamentals as it was mainly caused by smartphones, which was widely anticipated, and not by memory semiconductors, the tech titan’s core business.
Major issues and earnings outlook Share price corrections, initially triggered by sluggish iPhone X sales, are still ongoing although Apple ( AAPL ) is expected to place orders for its new iPhone soon. The biggest factor weighing on shares seems to be worries that OLED orders for new smartphones slated for a 2H18 release could fall below the market’s expectations. Having said that, if the production volume for the OLED models exceeds 40mn units, the utilization rates of modules should pick up, which will have positive impacts on 3Q18 operating profit and NAND TLC prices. We note the massive potential of the flexible OLED market, with the company gearing up to unveil its ultra-premium smartphones with foldable OLED displays in 1H19.
Share price outlook and valuation We recommend a buy-and-hold strategy in light of: 1) the prospect of a V-shaped recovery in 3Q18; 2) quarterly dividend; and 3) attractive valuation.
Disclosure: I/we have no positions in any stocks mentioned, and no plans to initiate any positions within the next 72 hours.
